verses.text: When anyone brings a grain offering to the LORD, it must be fine flour. Pour oil on it and put incense on it.

Bring it to Aaron's sons, the priests. The priest will take a handful of the flour and oil, with all the incense, and burn it on the altar as the part that is remembered. It is a gift made by fire, with a smell that pleases the LORD.
The rest of the grain offering belongs to Aaron and his sons. It is a most holy part of the gifts made by fire to the LORD.
When you bring a grain offering baked in an oven, it must be flat bread made without yeast, from fine flour mixed with oil, or thin wafers without yeast, spread with oil.
If your grain offering is cooked on a flat pan, it must be fine flour without yeast, mixed with oil.
Break it into pieces and pour oil on it. It is a grain offering.
If your grain offering is cooked in a pot, it must be made of fine flour with oil.
Bring the grain offering made from these things to the LORD. Give it to the priest, and he will take it to the altar.
The priest will take the part that is remembered from the grain offering and burn it on the altar. It is a gift made by fire, with a smell that pleases the LORD.
The rest of the grain offering belongs to Aaron and his sons. It is a most holy part of the gifts made by fire to the LORD.
No grain offering you bring to the LORD may be made with yeast. Do not burn any yeast or any honey as a gift made by fire to the LORD.
You may bring them to the LORD as a gift of the first part of your harvest, but they must not be burned on the altar as a pleasing smell.
Put salt on every grain offering. Do not leave out the salt of your God's covenant from your grain offering. Add salt to all your offerings.
If you bring the LORD a grain offering from the first part of your harvest, bring fresh heads of grain, roasted in the fire and crushed.
Put oil on it and lay incense on it. It is a grain offering.
The priest will burn some of the crushed grain and some of the oil, with all the incense, as the part that is remembered. It is a gift made by fire to the LORD.
